title: Green tea
text: Green tea is made from unoxidised leaves of Camellia sinensis. Steeping it too hot makes it bitter.

title: Black tea
text: Black tea leaves are fully oxidised before drying, which gives a darker colour and stronger flavour.

title: River Liffey
text: The Liffey flows through the centre of Dublin and reaches the Irish Sea at Dublin Bay.

title: River Shannon
text: The Shannon is the longest river in Ireland, running for over three hundred kilometres.

title: Saturn
text: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and is known for its bright ring system.

title: Jupiter
text: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system, a gas giant with a great red spot.
